newsitem.title: USA: ComEd Byron power plant output at 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: ComEd Byron power plant output at 20 pct.

text.p: Electricity production at Commonwealth Edison Co's Byron 2 nuclear generating station was cut to 20 percent of its rated 1,105 Megawatt (MW) capacity, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Friday.
The plant, in Byron, Ill., was operating at full power Thursday.

The NRC's daily report listed the cause of the reduction as "replacing a pressure switch on a feedwater isolation valve." No esimated restart date was given in the report, which is based on information from the plant's operator.
The facility's adjacent unit, Byron 1, was operating at 97 percent of capacity, which is also rated at 1,105 MW.
Commonwealth Edison is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
